prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Stage: Redesign the companion pick screen into a stage layout featuring live animated preview cards and quick selection options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose a pet personality to live on your desktop.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Pet Choice: Shift account creation to occur after pet selection so users establish emotional attachment before signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "headline": "Save Your Companion to Your Account", "body": "Sign in to keep your custom pet synced across devices."}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop controls guide screen before finishing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_controls", "home_intro"]}}
3: [home, wait_info] Visual Waiting Progress Ticker: Add an engaging progress tracker and interactive tips carousel to the waiting generation screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Hatching Your Companion...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Preparing desktop assets", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Press Alt+Pet to interact anytime on desktop", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
4: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selector Split View Redesign: Redesign path selection into a side-by-side split visual card layout highlighting Instant vs Custom adoption.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "How Would You Like to Adopt?", "body": "Choose a pre-made companion or create a customized pet.", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Add an explicit safeguard helper hint on the sign in screen clarifying account restoration.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary email to keep all existing pets linked to your account.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Prevents reset & preserves active pets", "style": "subtle"}]}}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Customizer Fallback Step: Add a fallback pet customizer preset flow before photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_customizer", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}}
7: [finish, copy] Direct Launch Call-to-Action: Update final screen button copy and headline to emphasize instant desktop activation.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Click below to summon your companion directly onto your desktop workspace.", "button_label": "Release Pet to Desktop"}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Alert Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts and audio chime when pet asset rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play chime when finished", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Streamlined Onboarding Story Copy: Simplify intro story text to clearly explain desktop pet capabilities in 3 brief points.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet lives on your desktop, interacts with your workflow, and keeps you company while you work.", "button_label": "Begin Setup"}}

Valid reordering of sign-in within onboarding without omitting required steps.
Valid addition of a new tutorial screen before home intro inside onboarding.
Valid waiting screen updates providing progress information and user tips.
Valid split-view redesign offering options for both adopting and creating a custom pet.
Valid addition of informative helper text to the sign-in screen.
Valid addition of a customizer fallback screen within onboarding flow.
Valid copy updates to the home intro screen.
Valid notification and sound additions for waiting screen completion.
Valid copy update to story screen that continues to introduce the pet.
